ActionMenu.title: ActionMenu

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click More, or focus it and press Enter, Space or ArrowDown (ArrowUp starts on the last action); arrows move, Enter or Space runs, Escape closes.

Button.title: Button

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click it, or Tab to it and press Enter or Space: each calls onClick. Change the variant, size and label in Controls.

stories.name: Disabled
stories.description: Faded to 40 %: no hover, no press, a click doesn't call onClick, and Tab skips it.

stories.name: In a form
stories.description: Type a name and press Enter, or click Save: the output shows the submitted data, with the Save button's name and value. Reset empties the field.

CommandPalette.title: CommandPalette

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the field or press ⌘K, type to filter ("sh", "sha"), then use the arrow keys and Enter.

CopyButton.title: CopyButton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click, or press Enter or Space, to copy the value: "Copied" shows for 1.5 s, then the icon returns.

HoldButton.title: HoldButton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Press and hold, or hold Space or Enter: let go early and the fill springs back; hold until it is full and it turns into a check for 1.5 s.

IconButton.title: IconButton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click it, or Tab to it and press Enter or Space: each calls onClick. The label is its accessible name; change it, the variant and the size in Controls.

MorphButton.title: MorphButton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click to run a fake request: loading for 1.2 s, done for 1.5 s, then back to idle.

stories.name: In a form
stories.description: Submit by clicking Save or pressing Enter in the field; the button loads, succeeds, then returns to idle.

stories.name: Disabled
stories.description: Disabled while idle: pointer and keyboard presses do not start the request.

SelectionBar.title: SelectionBar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Check tasks to raise the bar, all ten to see it widen as the count rolls; Tab to its actions and press Enter or Space; × or Delete empties the selection and the bar sinks away.

SwipeButton.title: SwipeButton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag the knob to the end, or focus the button and press Enter or Space, to confirm; let go early and it springs home. The done state resets after 1.5 s.

Toolbar.title: Toolbar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Tab into the toolbar and move with the arrow keys, Home and End, or hover the buttons: one tooltip glides between them and blur-swaps its text.

Checkbox.title: Checkbox

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the box or its label, or focus the box and press Space, to check and uncheck it.

CheckboxGroup.title: CheckboxGroup

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click labels or Tab between the choices and press Space; disabled choices are skipped.

stories.name: In A Fieldset Inside A Form

props.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]

ColorPicker.title: ColorPicker

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag in the area or move its knob with the arrow keys, slide the hue, or type a hex and press Enter.

props.default:
(saturation: number, brightness: number) =>
    `Saturation ${saturation.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "percent" })}, brightness ${brightness.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "percent" })}`

ColorSwatches.title: ColorSwatches

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a swatch or Tab in and use the arrow keys: the ring stretches toward the new swatch, then catches up.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; color: string; }[]

Combobox.title: Combobox

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the field or press ArrowDown to open, or type to filter ("a", then "al"); the arrows move, Enter or a click picks, Escape closes.

stories.name: In A Form
stories.description: Press Save without a sort order: the error shows inside the field until you pick one. Reset clears it.

stories.name: In A Field Near The Bottom
stories.description: Near the bottom the menu opens upward and the pill stays in place; press Save first to see the list take the error row's place.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

DatePicker.title: DatePicker

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a day, or Tab in, move with the arrow keys, Page Up/Down and Home/End, and press Enter or Space: the pill slides to the picked day, and months blur-swap in the direction you move.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

DateRangePicker.title: DateRangePicker

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Pick a start and an end day by click, or with the arrow keys and Enter; the range previews while you hover or move focus; PageUp and PageDown change the month.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

EditableText.title: EditableText

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click or press Enter to edit; Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels and returns focus to the display.

Field.title: Field

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the label and type an email: a space or a second @ shows an error until you delete it.

stories.name: In A Form
stories.description: Fill the fields and press Send: the output shows the submitted form data. Reset empties every field.

Fieldset.title: Fieldset

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Tab through the address and edit it; the legend names the group.

stories.name: Disabled
stories.description: The fieldset disables every field inside it.

FileUpload.title: FileUpload

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click (or press Enter or Space) to pick a file, or drop one on the zone: a fake upload fills the pill in 2 s, the check shows for 1.5 s, then the zone comes back.

props.default: "Drop a file or click to upload"

Input.title: Input

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the field and type; the focus ring sits on the pill.

stories.name: With Icons
stories.description: A search icon leads the text inside the pill.

stories.name: Disabled And Read Only
stories.description: The first field is disabled. The second is read-only: Tab reaches it and you can select its text, but not change it.

MultiSelect.title: MultiSelect

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the pill, or focus it and press Enter, Space or an arrow key; toggle options with a click, Enter or Space while the menu stays open; Escape, Tab or a click outside closes.

stories.name: Empty
stories.description: No options: the open menu shows the empty text.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form
In A Field Near The Bottom
stories.description: Near the bottom the menu opens upward and the pill stays in place; press Save first to see the list take the error row's place.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

NumberInput.title: NumberInput

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Type a number, then Enter or leave the field to commit it; arrow keys step the value.

NumberStepper.title: NumberStepper

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click − and +, or Tab in and press the arrow keys, Home and End: the digits roll, and a press past either end stretches the stepper, which springs back.

OTPInput.title: OTPInput

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a cell and type or paste a code; Backspace clears and moves back, the arrow keys move between cells.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

PasswordInput.title: PasswordInput

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Type a password, then press the eye button (or Tab to it and press Enter) to show or hide it.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

RadioGroup.title: RadioGroup

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click an option or Tab in and use the arrow keys: the dot grows out of the first choice, then stretches as it slides.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean | undefined; }[]

RangeSlider.title: RangeSlider

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag either knob or press the track to move the nearer one; Tab to a knob and use the arrow keys, Home and End.

Rating.title: Rating

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the stars to preview and click one to rate, or Tab in and press the arrow keys, Home and End: the lime fill slides under the outlines.

SearchField.title: SearchField

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the button (or press Enter or Space) and type; Escape clears the text, and Escape on an empty field or leaving it folds it back.

Select.title: Select

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the pill, or focus it and press Enter, Space or an arrow key; pick with a click, Enter or Space; Escape or Tab closes.

stories.name: Empty
stories.description: No options: the open menu shows the empty text.

stories.name: In A Form
stories.description: Press Save without a sort order: the error shows inside the pill until you pick one. Reset clears it.

stories.name: In A Field Near The Bottom
stories.description: Near the bottom the menu opens upward and the pill stays in place; press Save first to see the list take the error row's place.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

Slider.title: Slider

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag the knob or press the track; Tab to it and use the arrow keys, Home and End; past either end it stretches and springs back.

TagInput.title: TagInput

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Type a tag and press Enter or a comma; Backspace in the empty field removes the last chip, × removes its chip.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form
stories.description: The label rests inside the field and floats up while it's focused or has tags or text; removing every tag shows the error inside the field. Save prints the submitted genres, Reset restores them and Disable dims the field.

stories.name: Label Above
stories.description: With `labelPlacement="above"` on the Field, its label sits above the field and the field looks as it does on its own.

TextField.title: TextField

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the field and type an email; a space shows an error until you delete it.

Textarea.title: Textarea

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Type past the third line: the field grows with its text.

stories.name: In A Field
stories.description: The label rests inside the field and floats up while it's focused or filled. Past 160 characters an error grows the field into a card; shorten the text to clear it.

stories.name: Label Above
stories.description: With `labelPlacement="above"` on the Field, its label sits above the field and the field looks as it does on its own.

ThemeToggle.title: ThemeToggle

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the switch or press Space: the sun draws its rays in and turns into a moon, and back.

TimePicker.title: TimePicker

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the pill or press Enter or Space to open it, then drag, flick or arrow a wheel; Enter, Escape or a click outside closes it.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

props.default:
(value: Time) =>
    new Date(2000, 0, 1, value.hours, value.minutes).toLocaleTimeString("en-US", { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" })

TimeWheel.title: TimeWheel

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag or flick a wheel and it lands on the nearest value; hours and minutes loop, AM/PM stretches past its ends. Tab to a wheel and press the arrow keys.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

Toggle.title: Toggle

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the switch or press Space to move its liquid knob.

ToggleGroup.title: ToggleGroup

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a chip, or Tab in, move with the arrow keys, Home and End, and press Space or Enter to toggle it.

stories.name: In A Field Inside A Form

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

Breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the … pill, or focus it and press Enter or Space, to show the hidden pages; click a page to navigate to it.

CollapsibleSidebar.title: CollapsibleSidebar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the panel button (or Tab to it and press Enter) to widen the rail into the sidebar and back; click an item, or move focus with ArrowUp and ArrowDown and open it with Enter or Space.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; href?: string | undefined; }[]

Link.title: Link

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the link to darken its underline, or press Tab to see its focus ring.

stories.name: With Link Provider
stories.description: Click Settings or Help center, or Tab to one and press Enter: `navigate` gets the path and the page stays. The changelog opens in a new tab, as does a ⌘-click.

PageDots.title: PageDots

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a dot or drag along the dots to scrub pages; past either end they stretch and spring back. Tab to them for the arrow keys, Home and End.

Pagination.title: Pagination

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a page or an arrow, or Tab in and press Enter or Space: the pill slides to the current page, and the numbers blur-swap when the range shifts.

SegmentedTabs.title: SegmentedTabs

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a segment, or Tab in and use the arrow keys, Home and End: the ink pill slides to it.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

SidebarNav.title: SidebarNav

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click an item, or Tab in, move focus with ArrowUp and ArrowDown and open it with Enter or Space: the ink pill stretches as it slides.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; href?: string | undefined; }[]

TabBar.title: TabBar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click an item, or Tab in, move focus with the arrow keys and press Enter: the pill slides and the icon swaps.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon: ReactNode; activeIcon: ReactNode; href?: string | undefined; }[]

Tabs.title: Tabs

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Choose a tab by click or with the arrow keys: the panel slides in from the chosen tab's side while its height springs, and Tab moves into it.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; content: ReactNode; }[]

UnderlineTabs.title: UnderlineTabs

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a tab, or Tab in and use the arrow keys, Home and End: the underline stretches toward the new tab, then catches up.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

WizardSteps.title: WizardSteps

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next: the line draws to the next step and the finished dot turns into a check; Back reverses it.

Alert.title: Alert

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next to step through info, warning and success: the color and icon morph, the text blur-swaps and the height follows it.

Badge.title: Badge

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the bell, or press Enter, to step through a dot, 9, 10, 100, 8, 0 and 3; 0 hides the badge.

EmptyState.title: EmptyState

stories.name: Default
stories.description: An empty view's title, description, icon and action; the action is an ordinary Button.

LoadingState.title: LoadingState

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A named loading status with a spinner; there is nothing to interact with.

NotificationList.title: NotificationList

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Mark a notification as read or dismiss it: dismissed rows blur out, the rest spring up, and focus moves to a remaining action.

props.type: { id: string; title: string; description?: ReactNode; time: ReactNode; read?: boolean | undefined; avatar?: { name: string; src?: string | undefined; } | undefined; }[]

ProgressBar.title: ProgressBar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next, or press Enter or Space, to step through 10 %, 40 %, 70 %, 100 % and unknown length.

stories.name: Indeterminate
stories.description: Unknown progress sweeps across the track; with reduced motion its segment stays in the center.

ProgressRing.title: ProgressRing

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next, or press Enter or Space, to add 25%; at 100% the ring closes into a check, then starts over from 0.

Skeleton.title: Skeleton

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A list item while it loads: the avatar and both lines pulse every 1.6 s; with reduced motion they hold still.

Spinner.title: Spinner
Spinner.description: A turning arc in the current text color. It's decorative: give the busy control or region its own name or status text. It stops turning when `--motion-duration-scale` is 0.

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Turns once every 0.8 s; with reduced motion it holds still.

StatusBadge.title: StatusBadge

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next to step through neutral, info, warning and success, on canvas and on paper: the color fades, the content blur-swaps and the width follows the label.

Toast.title: Toast

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Next, or press Enter or Space, to swap between sharing and success; the pill follows its content.

stories.name: Sharing
stories.description: Loading and success take turns every 1.2 s, like a toast that follows a request.

ToastStack.title: ToastStack

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the stack or Tab into it to fan it out; × (or Enter on it) dismisses a toast; Show a toast adds one that leaves after 4 s.

props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

Avatar.title: Avatar

stories.name: Default
stories.description: The portrait fades in once it has loaded; change `size` in Controls for 24, 32 or 44 px.

stories.name: Initials
stories.description: Without `src` the initials show at once: the first letters of the first and last words, or one letter for a one-word name.

AvatarGroup.title: AvatarGroup

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Six people with `max` 4: four overlapping avatars, then a "+2" circle for the rest; change `max` or `size` in Controls.

BarChart.title: BarChart

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the bars, or Tab in and use the arrow keys; Change data switches weeks.

DataTable.title: DataTable

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a sortable header, or Tab to it and press Enter or Space, to sort; Space checks a row; the header checkbox selects or clears this page's rows and keeps the other pages' selection.

stories.name: Loading
stories.description: While loading, placeholder rows stand in for the data and the table is marked busy.

stories.name: With Row Actions
stories.description: Each row has an action menu named after its invoice; the chosen action appears below the table.

props.type: ({ key: string; header: ReactNode; cell?: ((row: Row) => ReactNode) | undefined; align?: "start" | "end" | undefined; rowHeader?: boolean | undefined; } & { sortable?: boolean | undefined; })[]

DescriptionList.title: DescriptionList

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Order details in a card; when the list is narrower than 384 px, each label moves above its value.

DonutChart.title: DonutChart

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover a segment, or Tab in and use the arrow keys, to see its value; Change data springs the arcs to another week.

Icon.title: Icon
Icon.description: A line icon in the current text color, hidden from screen readers: the control around it carries the name.

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Change the size in Controls: the icon grows and its lines stay 1.5 px.

Kbd.title: Kbd

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A shortcut in running text; change the keys in `children`.

LineChart.title: LineChart

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the line, or Tab in and use arrows, Home or End, to see each day.

List.title: List

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A file list in a card; the long title truncates to one line and the sizes stay whole, also in a narrow window.

props.type: { id: string; title: string; description?: ReactNode; leading?: ReactNode; trailing?: ReactNode; }[]

NumberTicker.title: NumberTicker

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the number to step through 99, 100, 19, 20, 9, 1,000 and 999, shown at 48 px and 13 px.

StatTile.title: StatTile

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Change the reading; while the change is negative, the chip turns white and its arrow swings down.

Table.title: Table

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Customers by revenue: cells keep to one line except the company names, whose cell content wraps; numbers align right. When the table is wider than its container, Tab reaches the scroll area and the arrow keys scroll it.

stories.name: Wide
stories.description: Ten columns in a short, narrow container: the table scrolls both ways inside its surface, and the header stays on top.

props.type: { key: string; header: ReactNode; cell?: ((row: Row) => ReactNode) | undefined; align?: "start" | "end" | undefined; rowHeader?: boolean | undefined; }[]

Tag.title: Tag

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A static tag on a paper card; edit the label in Controls.

stories.name: Removable
stories.description: Remove the tag by click, Enter or Space, then restore it to try again.

Timeline.title: Timeline

stories.name: Default
stories.description: An activity log in a card; events with an icon show it in a circle on the line, the others a dot.

props.type: { id: string; title: string; description?: ReactNode; time?: string | undefined; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

TreeView.title: TreeView

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a row to select it and a chevron to open or close its folder; or Tab in, move with ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End, open, enter and leave folders with ArrowRight and ArrowLeft, type a name to jump, and select with Enter or Space.

stories.name: Selection In Closed Folder
stories.description: The selected file is inside closed folders, so the pill rests on the nearest visible folder; open src, then components, and it slides down to CommandPalette.tsx.

Accordion.title: Accordion

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a question to open it (the open one closes) and again to close it, or Tab to a header, move with ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End, and toggle with Enter or Space.

props.type: { value: string; label: string; content: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; }[]

AppShell.title: AppShell

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Press Tab once to show the skip link, then Enter to move focus to the page. From 1024 px the sidebar stays in view while the page scrolls (its bottom button folds it into a rail); below, the brand moves into the header and the tab bar is fixed to the bottom.

Card.title: Card

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Press Tab to focus the link; the padding comes from `className`.

stories.name: Ink
stories.description: Press Tab to focus the link: on ink, the focus ring is paper and the separator ink-3.

ExpandableCard.title: ExpandableCard

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the card, or Tab to it and press Enter, to open its details; press Escape or the × to fold it back.

Footer.title: Footer

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a link, or Tab to one and press Enter: the path above the footer changes. The groups sit side by side from 768 px of the footer's own width, in two columns from 448 px, stacked below.

props.type: { title: string; links: { label: string; href: string; }[]; }[]

Header.title: Header

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a link, or Tab to one and press Enter: the underline slides to it. Below 768 px, the menu button opens the links in a drawer. Scroll: the header stays on top.

PageHeader.title: PageHeader

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A page title with its description, breadcrumbs and actions; in a narrow container the actions wrap below the title.

Separator.title: Separator

stories.name: Default
stories.description: A vertical rule between two details, a horizontal one between two blocks, and one on ink, where the line turns ink-3.

SplitPane.title: SplitPane

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag the divider, or Tab to it and press ←, →, Home and End; dragged past either end, it stretches and springs back when you let go.

AlertDialog.title: AlertDialog

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Delete playlist: focus starts on Cancel; Escape or Cancel closes it, Confirm runs the action; the backdrop doesn't dismiss it.

BottomSheet.title: BottomSheet

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Open the sheet, then drag its grab strip down (a flick or past halfway closes it, a short drag springs back), tap the handle, click the backdrop or press Escape.

ContextMenu.title: ContextMenu

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Right-click the card, hold it on touch, or focus it and press Shift+F10 or the context-menu key; arrows move, Enter or Space runs, Escape or a press outside closes.

Dialog.title: Dialog

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Open dialog: the button grows into the dialog; Escape, the close button or the backdrop close it and focus returns to the button.

Drawer.title: Drawer

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Open the drawer, then drag its header toward the edge, press Close or Escape, or click the backdrop; focus returns to the button.

Island.title: Island

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the island, or Tab to it and press Enter, to expand it; press Escape or click outside to fold it. Next activity steps through a timer, a call and a download.

Popover.title: Popover

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click Details, or focus it and press Enter or Space; click outside or press Escape to close it.

stories.name: Placements
stories.description: Each popover opens toward its placement, and flips only when the viewport has more room the other way.

Tooltip.title: Tooltip

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Hover the button or Tab to it: after 400 ms the tooltip fades in above it; leave, blur or press Escape to hide it.

Carousel.title: Carousel

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag or flick the photos, swipe sideways on a trackpad or Shift-scroll a mouse wheel, press the arrows or the dots, or Tab to the photos and use ArrowLeft and ArrowRight; past the first and last photo the track stretches and springs back.

stories.name: Interactive Content
stories.description: Click Save trail or Trail guide: the click prints below. A press on them doesn't start a drag, and a drag that starts elsewhere on the slide never clicks them.

stories.name: Peek
stories.description: Drag, flick or use the arrows and dots: the current photo stays centered while its neighbours peek in at both sides.

stories.name: Rail
stories.description: Drag, flick or use the arrows and dots: the cards line up from the start and run past the carousel's right edge, where the page clips them.

stories.name: Arrows At End
stories.description: Press the arrows at the end of the row, or drag the dots at its start.

stories.name: Arrows On Sides
stories.description: Press the arrows over the photo's edges, or drag the photo; the dots below follow.

CompareSlider.title: CompareSlider

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Press or drag anywhere on the picture, or Tab to the handle and use the arrow keys, Home and End; past either edge the divider stretches and springs back.

Image.title: Image

stories.name: Default
stories.description: The image fades in once it has loaded; until then its box shows a quiet placeholder.

stories.name: Fallback
stories.description: The source can't be decoded, so the fallback takes the image's place, centered.

Lightbox.title: Lightbox

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click a thumbnail to grow it into the full view; the arrow keys or the side buttons move between images; Escape, the backdrop or the close button shrink it back.

MusicPlayer.title: MusicPlayer

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click the island to open the player; play, scrub the progress bar, then minimize it or press Escape to close it.

VideoControls.title: VideoControls

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Click play to run the drawn video; drag the progress bar to seek (playback waits while you hold it) or press ArrowLeft/ArrowRight on it; drag the volume past either end to stretch it, or use the arrow keys.

VolumeSlider.title: VolumeSlider

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Drag past either end: the slider stretches and springs back when you let go.

WaveformScrubber.title: WaveformScrubber

stories.name: Default
stories.description: Press or drag along the waveform to scrub, or Tab in and use the arrow keys, Home and End; past either end it stretches and springs back.
